title: beautiful-html review file (bh-review/1)
description: Comments one reviewer made on one document, exported from the page's Review panel (theme/modules/review.js). May be gzipped (.json.gz).

document.description: Path from the site root, e.g. docs/edge-rate-limiting-design.html

build.description: The build the page was rendered from when the file was exported.

commit.description: Git commit SHA; null when opened from file:// without a build stamp

dirty.description: true if the working tree had uncommitted changes (npm run serve / bundle)

commit.description: Commit of the page when this comment was written: `git show <commit>:<document>` is exactly what the reviewer saw

suggestion.description: Proposed replacement for the quoted text (kind = suggestion)

outdated.description: The quoted text could not be found in the page when exported

anchor.description: id of the nearest section heading or block (figure, step, table…); "" = before the first heading

anchorKind.description: section = from that heading to the next heading; block = that element

quote.description: The selected text, whitespace collapsed; null = the comment is about the whole anchor

prefix.description: Up to 32 chars before, for disambiguation

position.description: Offsets of `exact` within the anchor's text (rendered text, whitespace collapsed, theme-injected UI excluded)
